events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) establishes screening position outside of da Silva's (ORL) field of view and marginal contact occurs as the pick is set.
Jokic (DEN) establishes a screening position outside of Black's (ORL) field of view and marginal contact occurs as the pick is set.
Murray (DEN) does not get his arm into a vertical position prior to initiating contact with Black's (ORL) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Jones (DEN) for contact with Carter Jr. (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Carter Jr. was deemed to commit a proximate foul on Jokic (DEN) prior to the called foul that was under review.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) extends his arm forward and initiates contact with Bane's (ORL) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) brings his off-arm to, not through, Black's (ORL) space and the contact that occurs as he releases away during his gather, is marginal.
Black (ORL) brings his arm forward and marginal brush contact occurs with Murray's (DEN) arm as he makes the pass.
Watson (DEN) is in Black's (ORL) path before the contact and absorbs it in his chest.
Carter Jr. (ORL) and Jokic (DEN) both have two hands on the ball and a jump-ball is correctly called.

Replay review of the foul called on Jokic (DEN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. The first illegal contact occurs after Carter Jr. (ORL) grabs and holds Jokic's (DEN) arm, initiating contact that affects his ability to pursue the jump-ball.
Brown (DEN) moves forward into Bane's (ORL) path and initiates illegal foot-to-foot contact during his gather, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Black (ORL) extends his arm forward and initiates illegal contact with Murray's (DEN) wrist, which causes him to lose control of the ball as he rips-through.
Black (ORL) legally contests Murray's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
